OK ATTACH role=queen
OK ECHO path=/queen/schedule/ctl bytes=75
OK CAT path=/proc/schedule/summary
END
OK CAT path=/proc/schedule/queue
END
OK ECHO path=/queen/lease/ctl bytes=90
OK ECHO path=/queen/lease/ctl bytes=50
OK CAT path=/proc/lease/summary
END
OK CAT path=/proc/lease/active
END
OK CAT path=/proc/lease/preemptions
END
OK ECHO path=/queen/export/ctl bytes=41
OK ECHO path=/queen/export/ctl bytes=57
OK ECHO path=/policy/ctl bytes=112
OK ECHO path=/policy/ctl bytes=39
OK QUIT
